---

Auburn Parks, Arts & Recreation manages nearly 1,000 acres of parkland and over 20 miles of trails, offering various outdoor activities. The Auburn Farmers Market operates seasonally from June to September at Les Gove Park. The Auburn Community & Event Center provides a wide range of fitness options, including numerous classes, an open gym, and a weight room. The department focuses on creating opportunities for children to play and engage in recreational activities. The city also highlights its legislative priorities for 2026, emphasizing community health and safety information, including details on measles awareness.
